name: obsidian-para
description: Three skills for maintaining an Obsidian vault organized by PARA: wiki-lint, wiki-process, standup-notes. See config.example.md for the placeholders you need to fill in.

wikiRoot.description: Relative or absolute path to your Obsidian vault root (e.g. 'Wiki' or '~/Documents/MyVault').

workDiaryBase.description: Path under WIKI_ROOT where daily work-diary entries live (e.g. '01-Areas/Career/Work-Diary').

standupNotesBase.description: Path under WIKI_ROOT for synthesized standup notes (e.g. '01-Areas/Career/Standup-Notes').

companyName.description: Your employer's name, used in skill prose and tags (e.g. 'Acme Corp').

companyContextNote.description: Vault-relative path to a note describing your company's standup cadence and org context (e.g. '${WIKI_ROOT}/01-Areas/Career/Acme.md'). Optional — skill will ask for cadence explicitly if absent.

obsidianVaultName.description: Your Obsidian vault's display name as Obsidian sees it (used for `obsidian://` URIs and `obsidian` CLI commands). Find it in Obsidian settings → About → Vault name.

inboxBase.description: Folder name for unprocessed captures at the vault root. Vanilla PARA users can use 'Inbox'.

areasBase.description: Folder name for ongoing life areas at the vault root. Vanilla PARA users can use 'Areas'.

projectsBase.description: Folder name for defined-outcome projects at the vault root. Vanilla PARA users can use 'Projects'.

resourcesBase.description: Folder name for reference material at the vault root. Vanilla PARA users can use 'Resources'.

journalBase.description: Folder name for journal entries at the vault root. Vanilla PARA users can use 'Archive' or omit this folder entirely.

mocBase.description: Folder name for Maps of Content at the vault root. Vanilla PARA users can use 'Maps' or omit this folder entirely.
